Trenerka personalna i dietetyczka sporto: Personal trainer and sports nutritionist from Warsaw. I help busy people get back in shape without turning their lives upside down – I build your workout plan and meal plan around your schedule, your equipment and the food you like. Most of my clients want to lose a few kilos, get stronger and look after their back while working at a desk.
